note: Adapted from the species description of Chhotani (1997), originally in English; the alate is not described and the worker is known only from measurements in earlier accounts; synonyms, literature citations, distribution and figure numbers are omitted.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head brown; antennae paler than the head; mandibles black, dark brown at the base; body and legs pale brown. Pilosity sparse on the head, denser on the body. Body length about 7.0 mm. Head capsule broadly oval, subrectangular in outline, sides slightly convex and narrowed anteriorly; 2.24–2.4 mm long to base of mandibles, 1.8–1.90 mm maximum width; width of mandible base 1.35 mm; head index (maximum width to length) 0.783; head convergence index 0.665. Antennae broken in the paratype, only 14 segments preserved. Labrum subtriangular, apex narrow and pointed; 0.33 mm long, 0.40 mm wide. Mandibles short and stout, tips incurved; left mandible 1.30 mm long, broken at the tip; right mandible 1.35 mm long, slightly more than half the head length; ratio of mandible length to head length 0.541. Left mandible with a rather large tooth slightly below the middle; tooth distance 0.73 mm; ratio of tooth distance to mandible length 0.651. Minute tooth of the right mandible slightly below the level of the left mandibular tooth; tooth distance 0.78 mm. Postmentum subrectangular, broad posteriorly; 1.58 mm long, 0.75 mm maximum width. Pronotum saddle-shaped; 0.80 mm long, 1.43–1.48 mm wide; anterior and posterior margins both distinctly notched.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: No specimens available. According to Holmgren and Holmgren (1917), the large worker is 5.0 mm long, with a head width of 1.82 mm and a pronotal width of 0.95 mm.
